areas.label: Start Here: HCM Foundations
areas.practice: Read the payroll calendars, track transactions in the notifications bell, protect confidential data, and know what each new person needs before day one.

areas.label: Positions, Recruitment & Hiring
areas.practice: Build positions and requisitions right the first time, and never let anyone start before they are cleared and converted.

areas.label: Payroll & Timecards
areas.practice: Get transactions in before the cutoff, check time cards weekly, route problems to the manager, and escalate late approvals.

areas.label: Assignments
areas.practice: Process hours changes, transfers, and departures with the right transaction and the right effective date.

areas.label: Leave Management
areas.practice: Get leave needs to the leave team fast, put time off in the right system for the worker, and keep the record and status in step.

areas.label: Costing Management
areas.practice: Charge pay to the right accounts, fix past periods through the retro process, and review costing after every move.

areas.label: Student & Faculty Hiring and Assignments
areas.practice: Hire students who work as student workers, end assignments at term end, and use faculty setups for faculty.

areas.label: Document Records & Reporting
areas.practice: File final signed documents as Document Records, and run reports that answer the real question.
